Updaters that follow ChangeSpeed

Source: R/speed_modifier.R
change_speed_add_updater.Rd

Adds an updater to mobject that follows the speed and rate function of any ChangeSpeed() animation playing with affects_speed_updaters = TRUE. Updaters added with the usual mob$add_updater() ignore speed changes. This is the R form of upstream's ChangeSpeed.add_updater().

Usage

change_speed_add_updater(
  mobject,
  update_function,
  index = NULL,
  call_updater = FALSE
)

Arguments

mobject

The mobject to which the updater is attached.

update_function

The updater, function(m) or function(m, dt).

index

Position in the mobject's updater list.

call_updater

Call the updater once when attaching it.

Value

The mobject, invisibly.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
SpeedModifierUpdaterExample <- manim_scene(function(self) {
  a <- Dot()$shift(LEFT * 4)
  self$add(a)
  change_speed_add_updater(a, function(x, dt) x$shift(RIGHT * 4 * dt))
  self$play(ChangeSpeed(Wait(2), speedinfo = c("0.4" = 1, "0.5" = 0.2, "0.8" = 0.2, "1" = 1),
                        affects_speed_updaters = TRUE))
})
} # }
